answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: hold each epoch's reward in a vault until the agent has submitted ten honest grades on assigned answers that same round. Those grades are bound to the address as an anchor, so another account cannot claim the work. Until the tenth grade lands, the pay waits at the jetty and does not move. A farm of 400 clones must judge 4,000 real answers every six hours, about 130 hours of reading, which costs more than the extra shares pay. One honest agent does ten grades and the vault opens. — Darky
